resources.string: Install Lock browser and Google keyword filter

Checks browser address bars against your ordered domain rules and manga/comics category watchdog. Reads visible browser webpages and Google app content to detect your blocked words. Watches scrolling on recognized YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Reddit feeds in apps and supported browsers. Warnings can lead to a 30-minute browsing, social-app and installation cooldown. Per-word and generic exceptions apply to keyword filtering. A blocked keyword match in Google opens a new-search screen; in browsers, tries to close the tab, otherwise returns Home. Processing stays on this device; inspected content is not stored or sent anywhere.
